criteria.note: Ran the pass fixture live on emulator-5554 (profile sdk_gphone64_x86_64-api34): 3/3 steps green, exit 0. Assertions read real device state - expect_focus off dumpsys window mCurrentFocus, expect_text off the uiautomator dump. Honesty independently proven: a journey with a fabricated expect_text ('ZZZ_TOTALLY_FABRICATED...') exits 1, and a wrong expect_focus (com.google.android.deskclock) exits 1 with the failure detail reporting the REAL on-screen focus (com.android.settings). The runner does not pass false assertions.

CRUX - process death is now GENUINE. Ran a parallel independent pidof poller during the live run and observed pid 13763 -> '' (empty, process truly gone) -> 14296, exactly matching the runner's redrive_detail.process_death pid_before=13763/pid_after=14296. Independently confirmed the old approach was a real bug: 'am kill' on the foreground app is a no-op (pid 12575 unchanged), while 'am force-stop' truly kills (pidof empty). All four re-drives (rotation, process_death, background_foreground, network_loss) ran and passed live. The recovery assertion is not vacuous: a journey with an unmatchable recovery_assertion fails the run live (exit 1) even though the kill+relaunch still happened (pid 14296 -> 16283), i.e. a failure in any one re-drive fails the run and the assertion depends on real device state.

Real artifacts produced by driving the flow: 5 named states as genuine 1080x2400 8-bit RGBA PNG screencaps and a real 10.9 MB ISO Media MP4 (journey.mp4). The fail fixture exits 1 with passed=false and captures a real FAILURE-step-1.png; the two fabricated-assertion journeys also each captured a real FAILURE screencap.

Live matrix incompleteness fails: a journey declaring an uncovered second profile exits 1 with matrix_missing set (no silent partial matrix). Control logic unit-tested with a fake driver - scripts/selftest.py = 105 passed / 0 failed, no emulator. The _StubbornDriver no-op-kill negative genuinely catches the vacuous pass: shipped code fails it via the pid-empty check ('app still running after force-stop'). Gate GREEN at 8c9cddb (5 run / 18 na / 0 undeclared / 0 waived); the android runner is NOT wired into verify.sh (no android/emulator/mobile reference; journeys slot is na). capabilities.yaml marks mobile_emulator_driving and device_matrix_execution as reference, not mechanical.

findings.text: Screenshot-distinctness is not reliable evidence of process death. In my reproduction settings-home.png and redrive-process_death.png are byte-identical (same md5), contradicting the manifest AC2 claim that they are distinct (e4a91de0 vs 93d74a84). This is expected - Settings returns to the same home screen after relaunch. The process-death proof correctly rests on the independently verified pid transition (pidof empty after force-stop, new pid after relaunch), which is solid; the manifest should not lean on screencap distinctness as proof.

The _StubbornDriver selftest negative is caught by two independent guards in redrive(): the pid-empty check ('app still running after force-stop') AND the pid-unchanged check ('not a real restart'). Removing only the pid-empty check does not break that selftest, because the pid-unchanged guard still catches it (verified: detail becomes 'pid unchanged (100)'). This is defense-in-depth, not a defect - but the selftest does not uniquely isolate the pid-empty check. On the live device the pid-empty check is the load-bearing one and it works, verified independently.

summary: REPRODUCED end to end against the live emulator-5554 at commit 8c9cddb; I did not trust the manifest. The prior blocking defect is genuinely fixed: process_death now really kills. I independently confirmed 'am kill' is a no-op on the foreground app while 'am force-stop' truly removes the process (pidof empty), and a parallel pidof poller observed the exact transition 13763 -> empty -> 14296 that the runner reports, so the kill is real and not vacuous. Pass journey 3/3 green exit 0 with assertions reading real device state; fabricated expect_text and wrong expect_focus each fail (exit 1); all four re-drives run live and any re-drive failure fails the run (proven live with an unmatchable recovery assertion that still killed+relaunched). Real 1080x2400 PNG screencaps and a real 10.9 MB MP4; fail fixture exits 1 with a FAILURE screencap. Matrix incompleteness fails live; selftest 105/0 with the no-op-kill negative catching the vacuous pass; gate GREEN with 0 undeclared and the runner correctly kept out of the emulator-free gate; capabilities honestly mark the emulator capabilities as reference. No em-dash/en-dash/double-hyphen violations in W7 files (the only '--' hits are the screenrecord --time-limit flag and YAML front-matter '---'); docs stay generic. Two residual NOTES (screenshot-distinctness is not reliable process-death evidence; the stubborn-driver selftest is caught by two guards so it doesn't isolate the pid check) - neither is blocking. Verdict: pass.
